name: KiCad GUI Driver
description: In-process wx GUI-driver helper: lets the KiCad MCP harness enumerate and trigger menus, AUI toolbar tools and plugin actions over a localhost JSON-lines socket.
description_full: Starts a background listener on 127.0.0.1 (JSON lines, one request per line) inside pcbnew/eeschema. Commands (tree/click/run_plugin/wait_for/scrape/click_button/screenshot) are marshalled to the wx UI thread via wx.CallAfter; the listener thread never touches wx directly. This is the second channel to KiCad next to kipy: kipy = design content, gui-driver = chrome.
